title: White House Urges Easing Liability to Encourage AI Disclosure
description: At a White House meeting on Thursday, officials from President Donald Trump’s artificial intelligence task force recommended that agencies ease their cyber liability policies in an effort to incentivize AI companies to report critical incidents.

title: Fed’s Jefferson Says Inflation Will Determine Rate Decisions
description: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said inflation has become the most important measure for policymakers as they consider additional interest-rate hikes.

title: SpaceX Starship Launches on Flight Test of Reusability
description: SpaceX’s Starship rocket took off from the Starbase launch facility in South Texas on a flight test to bring both sections of the vehicle safely back to Earth. Ed Ludlow reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
